title: Eventual descent of finite-presentation flatness
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Fix i\in I, let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme], put X=X_i\times_{S_i}S and X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j for j\ge i [def-pc-base-change], and let \mathcal{F}_i be a finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_{X_i}-module. If the pullback of \mathcal{F}_i to X is flat over S [def-pc-morphism-conventions], then there is j\ge i such that the pullback of \mathcal{F}_i to X_{j'} is flat over S_{j'} for every j'\ge j.
